revisions.goal: Let users remove stale plan requests from the visible approval queue.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria:
- Stale plan requests expose a clear remove/dismiss action in the macOS approval app
- Removing a stale plan hides it from the approval queue without deleting locked/completed plan history
- Pending approvable plans cannot be removed through this stale-only action
- API and Swift tests cover stale removal and invalid removal states

milestones.title: Add stale removal API
milestones.goal: Expose a trusted-local endpoint that transitions stale plan requests out of the review queue

milestones.title: Add native remove action
milestones.goal: Show a remove stale plan button and refresh the queue after success

milestones.title: Verify behavior
milestones.goal: Run focused Go and Swift tests plus build checks
